scope: 맵1 전투방 이후 하강 착지부터 하단 연습길을 거쳐 왼쪽 첫 보스 B1 입구까지

assets.title: 착지 지점 폐기둥 잔해
assets.placement: 전투방 하강 통로의 안전 착지면 뒤쪽
assets.reference_decisions: Subject: ONE low asymmetrical group of three fallen dark-stone column fragments, physically touching and tangled together with roots. Main fragment lies diagonally down toward LEFT to gently guide the route leftward; two smaller pieces hug its base. One broken hexagonal carving face, no readable symbols. Moss dense at outside ends, central stone plane plain. Low and wide, no sharp spikes or bright glow so this reads safe. Decorative foreground/midground rubble, not a required interactable. Landscape 3:2 canvas. References SS-MG-03: safe landing edge and vertical cave depth; HK-GP18: foliage grouped along ruin edges.
assets.integration_notes: 장식/지형 후보 이미지. 배치·크기·충돌은 후속 구현에서 결정.

assets.title: 벽점프 연습 돌기둥
assets.reference_decisions: Subject: ONE tall narrow rectangular ruined stone pillar for wall-jump practice, height 2.8 times width, flat clearly readable walkable top, TWO straight uninterrupted vertical solid side faces suitable for wall contact. Rounded chipped top corners and one wide dark recess on center front, a single subdued angular carving near upper third. Moss and leaves only in shallow clusters on top and front, no large leaves protruding sideways across the vertical contact line. Heavy stone plinth at bottom. Dark blue-teal body has a near-black broad central mass; thin lighter outline marks top and side contact boundaries. Portrait 2:3 canvas. References SS-MG-03: legible safe ledge on a vertical wall; HK-CT-05: strong silhouette of a traversable pillar.
assets.integration_notes: 그림의 상면·측면에 맞춘 충돌은 추후 수동 설계. 잎·덩굴은 장식.

assets.title: 짧은 돌다리 발판
assets.placement: 하단 연습길의 작은 단차·가시 구간 위쪽
assets.reference_decisions: Subject: ONE freestanding horizontal stone bridge/platform span, roughly 4 times wider than tall. Clear continuous level walkable top, slightly chipped outside rim, three broad stones across the top. Below it two shallow angular support arches with transparent holes and a dark solid stone core between them. A few roots and small rounded leaves hang only under the two ends, leaving the upper walking surface free. Carved angular lines are subdued, no glowing strips on walk surface. No pillars continuing outside canvas, no rails or chains. Broad landscape canvas, object fills width with generous margins. References HK-CT-05: clear elevated walking surface over an architectural underside; HK-GP18: restrained moss and dark interior mass.
assets.integration_notes: 장식/지형 후보 이미지. 배치·크기·충돌은 후속 구현에서 결정.

assets.title: 하단 연습길 가시 덩굴
assets.placement: 유물 설치·복귀를 연습하는 짧은 위험 구간
assets.reference_decisions: Subject: ONE low horizontal bed of dangerous mutant blade-shaped thorn plants rooted into a thin dark rock strip. Use input image 3, our original thorn sprite, for its olive-brown curved blades and pale pointed tips. Restyle into the moss cave's clean hand-drawn appearance. About 13 clearly separated upward-pointing tapered curved thorns, irregular heights and alternating lean directions; middle thorns are taller. Wide 5:1 overall silhouette, no flowers, no round safe-looking leaves covering the thorn tips, no bright green glow. Tangled brown roots and tiny dark olive buds only along base, completely transparent above and around points. Landscape wide canvas. References HK-GP18 and SS-MG-02: leaf-group spacing, clear separation of foreground boundary from empty route; danger silhouette is original project thorn source.
assets.integration_notes: 기존 가시의 짧은 칼날형 식물과 연결한 외형. 피해·복귀·충돌은 기존 규칙으로 별도 연결.

assets.title: 보스 전실 길잡이 석등
assets.placement: B1 직전 안전 공간의 벽 쪽
assets.reference_decisions: Subject: ONE squat ancient stone waymarker lantern on a low mossy base, height 1.4 times width, a broken hexagonal upright stone slab with a small inset sheltered amber lantern aperture near its upper center. Warm restrained amber light only inside the physical recess, no external glow or halo. One original shallow angular chevron carving below the recess points LEFT toward B1. A short root curls around left foot; a few rounded leaves collect at right foot. No bench, no seat, no interactable crystal or relic. This is a visual landmark for a safe waiting alcove only, it does not introduce healing or new game mechanics. Square canvas. Reference SS-MF-04: one tiny warm functional landmark in a dark safe pocket, without copying its bench or suspended lamp; HK-GP18: moss and aged passage stone.
assets.integration_notes: 안전 공간의 시각적 길잡이. 회복·저장·체크포인트 기능을 새로 확정하지 않음.

assets.title: 첫 보스 B1 입구 폐아치
assets.placement: 하단 연습길 왼쪽 끝·B1 안전 공간과 보스방 경계
assets.reference_decisions: HK-GP18의 식생 문턱 외곽과 HK-CT-05의 읽기 쉬운 아치 구조를 프로젝트 육각 석재로 변형. 아치 외곽과 통로 안쪽은 투명하게 요청.
assets.integration_notes: 장식/지형 후보 이미지. 배치·크기·충돌은 후속 구현에서 결정.
